# Earth.Org

> > Earth.Org is a nonprofit environmental journalism platform providing climate action resources, sustainability guides, and community engagement for addressing global environmental challenges.

Earth.Org delivers evidence-based content on environmental issues including climate change, pollution, sustainable practices, and conservation. The platform combines investigative journalism with community action through its Movement.Earth.Org membership portal, empowering readers to engage with climate solutions and environmental consciousness.

## Key Topics

- Climate Action
- Environmental Journalism
- Sustainability
- Water Pollution
- Carbon Emissions
- Ecotourism
- Climate Communications
- Sustainable Travel
- Green Investment
- Environmental Consciousness
- Community Engagement
- COVID-19 Environmental Impact
- Tourism Impact
- Conservation Solutions

## Community & Membership

- [HOME | Movement.Earth.Org](https://www.movement.earth.org/): Earth.Org membership portal for climate action community and followers

## Environmental Issues & Solutions

- [Water Pollution: Causes and Solutions](https://earth.org/what-are-the-causes-of-water-pollution/): Water pollution causes from oil spills to industrial waste and solutions

## Sustainability & Climate Action

- [What Is Ecotourism and Why It Matters in 2024 | Earth.Org](https://earth.org/ecotourism/): Guide to sustainable travel and ecotourism's environmental impact
